sections.A: Thoracic spine ki 12 vertebrae hain, har ek pasliyon se juri hai, is liye yeh hissa gardan aur kamar se zyada sakht hai. Mechanical dard joints, pasliyon ke jor ya muscles se aata hai.
sections.B: Shoulder blades ke beech ya reedh ke saath dard, kabhi seene ke gird. Der tak baithne, mudne ya gehri saans se barhta hai aur movement se kam hota hai.
sections.C: Sab se pehle yeh poochein ke kya dard mehnat se aata hai aur aaraam se jaata hai (dil), saans phoolna, bukhar ya wazan kam hona to nahi. Movement aur posture se badalta dard mechanical hota hai.
sections.D: Dil ya saans ka shak ho to pehle vital signs. Phir posture, movement, segment ki jaanch aur pasliyon ki jaanch.
sections.E: Baith kar rotation, PA pressure aur pasliyon ki springing se dhoondte hain ke kaun sa segment wahi dard deta hai.
sections.F: Dil ka dard, phephron ki bimari, pet ke andar ke masle aur fracture isi jaise lag sakte hain.
sections.G: Paseena, matli aur saans phoolne ke saath seene ya peeth ka dard, achanak cheerta hua dard, ya achanak saans ki takleef: foran emergency.
sections.H: Pehle andar ke organs aur dil-phephron ki wajah screen karein. Emergency ho to ruk jayein. Fracture ka risk ho to manipulation nahi. Dard movement se badle to mechanical.
sections.I: Thoracic manipulation, PA mobilisation aur pasliyon ki mobilisation se thori der ka aaraam aur behtar movement milti hai.
sections.J: Thoracic extension, open book rotation, cat-camel, prone Y-T-W aur breathing exercises.
sections.K: Garmi aaraam ke liye, TENS optional. Baqi machines aam taur par nahi.
sections.L: Screen karein, samjhayein ke yeh mechanical aur theek hone wala hai, phir mobility, phir taaqat aur posture mein variety, aur aakhir mein khud sambhalna.
sections.M: Dard, rotation, segment ka sign aur PSFS dobara dekhein. Naye jismani symptoms aayein to plan rok dein.
sections.N: 52 saal ke smoker ko seerhiyan charhte waqt peeth mein dard hua. Pehle khud socho yeh mechanical hai ya kuch aur, phir jawab dekho.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
